This case-sensitive code system https://mitre.org/fhir/space-health/CodeSystem/radioprotective-medication-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
nac N-Acetylcysteine (NAC)Antioxidant and glutathione precursor with radioprotective properties
amifostine AmifostineCytoprotective agent that scavenges free radicals generated by ionizing radiation
vitamin-e-succinate Vitamin E Succinate (Tocopherol)Fat-soluble antioxidant with radioprotective activity
selenium-methionine Selenium MethionineTrace element essential for antioxidant enzyme function
glutathione-precursor Glutathione PrecursorSupplements that increase intracellular glutathione levels
